description: French is the fallback donor for en, pl, ru and ar requests. French discriminates in the opposite direction from the Slavic donors: its one-rule is `i = 0,1`, so 0 selects ONE (where pl and ru say MANY, ar says ZERO and en says OTHER) and the decimal 1.5 also selects ONE because the rule tests i and ignores v. Its many-rule fires only at integer multiples of a million (or a compact exponent outside 0..5), which no other non-Portuguese locale here shares.
